name: model_view_video
description: Describe a short video with a dedicated omni-modal model and return a factual text description. The video URL is sent to the model, which watches the video itself; no local frame extraction happens and the result is text only. Use this when the primary agent needs a video description rather than raw frames.

url.description: HTTP/HTTPS URL of a short video.

focus.description: Optional aspect to prioritize, such as visible text, product placement, or motion.

model.description: Optional model override. Defaults to qwen3.5-omni-flash or the worker's MODEL_VIEW_VIDEO_MODEL setting.

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt that replaces the built-in default analysis prompt.

extra_params.description: Optional extra request fields. Sampling fields such as fps, min_frames, max_frames, min_pixels, max_pixels and total_pixels are attached to the video content part; every other key is merged into the request body. The frame budget defaults to min_frames=6 and max_frames=90.
